## Where I am
The real replay is done. Job `replay-1` produced all 18,442,107 events into `events.replay.v3`, and 3,118 schema v2 rejects went to S3. PR #233 is merged. The aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12 started at 08:57 UTC and was at 61% at 09:52, with 14.9M rows in the incident window against about 20.5M expected. The incident stays open until the counts match. (source: ses-rp-2, kestrel-analytics/ingest#233, r2-04, r2-06, r2-07)

- [en-cours] Aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12, reading `events.replay.v3` (source: r2-06)
- [en-cours] Daniel's CI check that fails if the dedup key builder can truncate (source: src-slack-incident)
- [prochaine-étape] Wait for the backfill to reach 100% (source: r2-06)
- [prochaine-étape] Compare ClickHouse counts hour by hour, with a 1% tolerance (source: r2-08)
- [prochaine-étape] Close the incident once the counts match (source: r2-07, r2-10)
- [essai-raté] Dry run with 50k batches was OOMKilled at the 2Gi limit; 5k batches work, and the memory limit stays untouched (source: r1-03, r1-04, src-sentry-oom)
- [question] Orbitly was told the data would be restored by Wednesday Nov 18, while Rachel gave Fernhill and Orbitly Thursday. Which date is confirmed? (source: src-zendesk-orbitly, r2-07)
- [question] What happens to the 3,118 schema v2 rejects in S3, which were not replayed? (source: r2-04)
- [décision] Keep every event: replay into `events.replay.v3` and never produce to `events.v3` from this tool (source: r1-02, src-slack-incident)
- [décision] The incident stays open until the counts match (source: r2-07)
- [décision] PR #241 from the fork is not merged; Daniel does the CI check instead (source: r2-09, src-slack-incident)
